title: Tampering
text: “This is something I received from Myne.”
“That’s exactly why I’m saying it’s stolen goods!”
“Don’t just make things up. Do you have any proof?!”
“Weapons and armor in this country have inscriptions and serial numbers. Where and by whom that chainmail was purchased—”
“Oink! Oink-oink!”
Just as I was about to present my evidence, the Crimson Swine stepped in and interrupted me in a loud voice.
“Don’t interrupt, Crimson Swine!”
I shoved him aside with a thud and said to Itsuki,
“It’s set up so we can tell.”
“…Is that really true?”
Itsuki asked Trash and Crimson Swine. Then Trash stroked his chin just once.
“Well then, Lord Kawasumi, might we see that chainmail? Let’s cross-check it.”
A soldier brought a tray over to Itsuki. Reluctantly, Itsuki took off his chainmail and placed it on the tray. After that… the soldier went over to Trash once and began the verification.
“It seems, according to our records, this chainmail was in our castle’s warehouse!”
That scum! It looks like he fabricated the records! It seems he’s got just enough wits to come up with something like that.
“That doesn’t change the fact that you stole it from the castle.”
“Oink! Oink-oink!”
At that moment, the Crimson Swine sprang to his feet and, walking with a foolish gait that pretended to be elegant, started making a commotion.
“Oink! Oink-oink-oink-oink…”
“I see… So Myne was a princess? In that case, the items from the castle certainly belong to her.”

Ugh… He fabricated evidence and revealed his own identity to claim he wasn’t a thief. It seems Itsuki has completely fallen for the Crimson Swine and that Trash’s delusional ramblings. However… Ren looks as though he has his doubts about this exchange.
“…There are many points that don’t add up, but it’s none of my business. It’s too early to judge which side is right.”
That said, Ren probably won’t take Father’s side here.
“That’s exactly it, Motoyasu-san! She isn’t a pig, nor is she evil. Didn’t she simply try to give you the castle’s belongings out of goodwill? Your response to that is absolutely unforgivable.”
“No matter what you say, a pig is a pig. To begin with, I can’t trust the verification done by the pig’s parents.”
“What did you say?!”
“The fact that she confessed to being a princess makes it even worse. After all, it’s easy for a princess to tamper with evidence.”

It happens all the time, doesn’t it? Stories where the children of the wealthy commit crimes, and their parents use their power to cover it up. That’s exactly what’s happening here. Besides, I’ve heard that under modern law, family testimony carries little weight as evidence. Well, I don’t know if that applies in this world, though.
“…Motoyasu does have a point.”
“Renn-san, whose side are you on?!”

“Hmph, I’m not on either side. But Motoyasu’s argument does hold some merit. If he were just a common adventurer, I might trust the king’s words, but when it comes to his daughter, that’s a different story. Besides, if the kingdom and the princess were really framing Naofumi, the evidence from earlier would have been tampered with by now.”
As Ren replied, Trash interjected.
“Hmm, Spear Hero, this audience is over. Please take your leave.”
“I refuse.”
Hearing Ren’s words, Trash—perhaps feeling flustered—seems to be trying to steer things toward kicking me out. Of course, I have no intention of leaving. I know what’s coming next, after all.
“Please leave!”
The soldiers are swarming around me, trying to force me out.
“Don’t touch me, you scum.”
I’ll sweep them aside with my spear.
“Motoyasu! If you don’t cut this out—”

Just as this exchange was happening, my father—wearing only his undershirt—was dragged in by the soldiers. As I expected, staying silent only leads to this. I have to rescue him from this disgusting farce as soon as possible!
“Myne!”
Trash and Itsuki glare at my father. Ren, however, remains silent.
“W-what’s with that attitude?”
I want to rescue my Father right this very moment. But I have to time it just right.
“…I haven’t finished talking with Motoyasu-san yet, but I suppose I have no choice. Do you really have no idea what you’re accused of?”
“What do you mean, ‘no idea’… Wait, ah!”
My Father pointed at Itsuki. His intuition really is sharp. No matter how many times I see this scene, it feels like my heart is about to break.
Those soldiers always get in the way. If they don’t cut it out, I’ll kill them—just like Smoked Meat!
“So you were the one stealing from the pillow!”
“Who’s stealing from the pillow?! Naofumi-san. I never would’ve thought you were such a scoundrel!”
“Scoundrel? What are you talking about?”
“You’re in the way.”
When I swept the soldiers aside, Ren and Itsuki turned toward me for just a moment. However, my Father seems to have gone completely blank—he doesn’t even seem to notice.
“So, what are the charges against the Shield Hero?”
Perhaps realizing I’m trying to take my Father’s side, the soldiers—even after being swept aside—immediately get back up and get in the way again. Do they realize I’m holding back?
“Charges? What are you talking about?”
“Bubub… Bub… Bubububububu!”
“Huh?”
“Bububububububububu!”
Well, no matter how much you lot plan to send my Father to hell, I, Motoyasu, will stop you.
I know. I know just how kind my real Father truly is.
I know. I know that even when he goes through painful experiences, his kindness never wavers.
I know. I know he possesses a heart as vast as the ocean—a heart that, even though I unwittingly framed him, impeached him, and drove him to the brink, still accepted me despite his words of refusal.
Yes, I must repay him. No matter how many times this loop repeats, it is my mission to repay the kindness my Father has shown me.
“Bubububububububub!”
“Huh?”
“What are you talking about? After we finished eating yesterday, I was just sleeping in my room.”
“That’s a lie! Then why is Myne crying so much?!”
Isn’t that obvious? It’s because you only think about yourself.
“You’re a pig, after all. She’s probably just faking those tears.”
“Please just shut up!”
Hmm, she got mad at me. I can’t even hear a word Itsuki is saying. Compared to Father’s anger, Itsuki’s indignation is nothing but trash.
“Why are you defending Myne? And where did you even get that chainmail?”

“Ah, yesterday, while we were all drinking together, Myne dropped by the tavern. After we’d been drinking together for a while, she gave me this chainmail as a present. And… this chainmail was actually from the castle.”
“No way…”
My Father seems at a loss for words. It’s true that if someone were to say it’s the same item, I suppose it might be possible.
“That’s it! Your Majesty! I was robbed in my sleep—all my possessions and every piece of equipment except my shield were stolen! Please, catch the culprit!”
“Shut up, you scoundrel! Forcing sexual acts on my unwilling subjects is an unforgivable atrocity—if you weren’t a hero, you’d be executed on the spot!”
Ren closed his eyes as if he’d realized something.
“That’s why I’ve been saying it’s a misunderstanding! I didn’t do it!”
And then… Father’s expression turned to rage.
“You! Don’t tell me you framed me for a crime I didn’t commit just to get your hands on my dowry and equipment!”
“Ha! What are you talking about, you sex offender?”
“Don’t mess with me! You were after my money from the start, weren’t you? You planned this to distribute the equipment among your companions!”

Well, I suppose it’s about time. It gives me an unpleasant feeling, as if I’d been waiting for my Father to be framed, but I’ll save him now. I put all my strength into the spears I held in both hands.
“…This just looks like a farce.”
The moment Ren muttered that, I swept aside the soldiers who were getting in my way.
“Get out of the way! Brionac!”
Turning him into a pile of charcoal right here would leave a bad impression, so I guess I have no choice. Just this once, I’ll go easy on him as a special favor.
“‘Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!’”
After sweeping them aside, I shoved the soldier holding my Father away with the shaft of my spear.
“…Huh?”
“I believe in my Father. He didn’t do it. This is a conspiracy.”
Spinning my spear in a circle, I aimed it at Trash and Itsuki.
“I suppose you’re taking advantage of the queen’s absence to do as you please, but looking at the state of this country right now, what do you think the queen would say?”
“You… Trash!”
Trash, furious that his conspiracy had been thwarted, glared at me. Immediately afterward, a voice asking a question rang in my ears.
“…The queen?”
I turned around to see Ren. Hmm, for some reason—I don’t know why—Ren seems to be listening to what I’m saying this time. Maybe I can convince him. But right now, saving my Father is the priority.
“This is the second time you’ve stepped in to protect my Father here. So, let’s use the same words…”
My Father looks up, clearly taken aback.
“I’ve come from the future to repay you for your kindness, Father.”
